manifesto.label: 0.01 — Manifesto
manifesto.p1: They charge you $30 to move cards. $50 to store contacts. $12 to shorten a link. Not for the software — out of habit.
manifesto.p2: But software is bits. And bits are free. They always were.
manifesto.p3: Zerosoft exists to prove it: we rebuild the tools that run the world and set the core free under AGPLv3. No lock-in. No fine print. Host it yourself, free, forever. Or we run it for you: you start free and pay only for what scales — clicks, bookings, emails, storage, seats. With prices in the open.
manifesto.final: Software is dead. We are what comes next.

oss.label: 0.03 — Open source
oss.title: Self-host it in one command.
oss.p: The core of every app is AGPLv3 — every core feature, no trial, no limits. Run it with Docker on any small VPS. Your data lives in one SQLite file and one uploads volume: back them up and you have everything.
oss.b1: AGPLv3 core with every core feature
oss.b3: Your data in one SQLite file you own
oss.b4: SSO, audit logs and custom roles (/ee) — in development

dev.label: 0.04 — Developers
dev.title: A real API.
dev.p: Create a personal key in settings and talk to Link, CRM and Cal over REST. Subscribe to events and verify every delivery with an HMAC signature.
dev.b1: Links, CRM contacts, companies, deals, tasks and pipelines, Cal event types and bookings.
dev.b2: zs_… keys shown once and stored hashed. 100 requests per minute.
dev.b3: link.created, link.clicked and booking.* events, signed with Zerosoft-Signature (HMAC-SHA256) and retried with backoff.

faq.label: 0.07 — FAQ
faq.title: Fair questions.
faq.a1: Yes. The core of every app is open source under AGPLv3 and self-hosting costs $0, forever. On Zerosoft Cloud you start on a free plan; if you scale, you pay for usage, with prices published before we ever charge you.
faq.a2: Convenience and companies. Zerosoft Cloud charges for usage beyond the free plan, and Enterprise is a commercial license with direct support. We never charge for the core.
faq.q3: What do I need to self-host?
faq.a3: Docker and a small server. Clone the repo, fill in .env and run docker compose up -d. Data lives in two volumes: a SQLite file and your uploads. Without Docker: npm ci, npm run build, npm start.
faq.q4: Can I migrate from the tools I use today?
faq.a4: Link imports from Bitly (API or CSV). CRM imports contacts and companies from any CSV, with column mapping and dedupe. Other importers, like Notion and Linear, aren't built yet.
faq.q5: What does AGPLv3 mean for my company?
faq.a5: You can use it, self-host it and modify it for free. If you offer a modified version as a service to others, you must publish your changes. The /ee folder is under a separate commercial license.
faq.q6: Do you have SSO and audit logs?
faq.a6: Not yet. SSO/SAML, audit logs, custom roles and white-label are in development as part of Enterprise. We'll say so here the day they ship.

end.label: 0.08 — Start
end.sub: Open the app and start free, or clone the repo and run it yourself. Either way, the core costs $0.
